verdict.rationale: Kit provides a documented REST API, OAuth, webhooks, and even MCP servers for agent access, which supports 'building against' the platform, but none of the evidence names an official client SDK (e.g., Python/JS libraries) and a probe for an OpenAPI spec (which typically backs SDK generation) returned only 404s. missing for 10: explicit official SDK/client library documentation, OpenAPI spec availability, independent confirmation of SDK usage.
